# DIRECTION — 03-passage-console

## Design thesis
Passage Log Console is a make-slot desk, not a boutique shelf: open on the primary product with trade facts on the plate edge; primary argument is material truth + “log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).” — never lifestyle hero; ban consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Passage Log Console
Audience: harbour masters logging vessel passages.
Primary action: log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).
Brand palette cues: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only
Anti-references: consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome.

## Hierarchy
1) primary subject object plate recognition 2) evidence facts 3) choice control (grade/size if evidenced) 4) log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes). 5) secondary SKUs — no fake ★/testimonials

## Signature
Make-slot control on Passage Log Console — primary CTA is the product, not a hero slogan

## Primary risk
Must not drift into banned tropes (consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradie); signature may overfit if evidence is thin.

## Axis record

- direction-version: 2.3
- composition: real interface full width as first screen
- type: Display: UI sans (Inter / system-ui) medium for section titles. Body: UI sans regular for labels and helper text. Utility: IBM Plex Mono for vessel IDs, timestamps, shortcuts. Seed structure: UI sans pair, tight tracking on tools.
- colour: fog grey panels; type/rules in near-black shell; accent only on primary CTA/hardware (amber for warnings only). Seed note: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only — brand evidence only; single reserved accent
- imagery: Deliberately imageless — chrome, type, and states carry the first screen; no stock illustration.
- rhythm: asymmetric tool rail + main canvas

- surface: framed — panels bound the work surface
- labels: symbol-led — tools speak as icons with text fallback
- figures: absent — no decorative metrics
- depth: inset — panels recede into the shell

- visual-density: 8
- motion-intensity: 1
- aesthetic-boldness: 3

- signature-selector: [data-signature="Make-slot control on Passage Log Console — primary CTA is the product, not a hero slogan"]
- signature-min-share: 12

## Implementation notes
